non_blocking_observations.description: The current Zig 0.16 test-integration wrapper path cannot be used as reliable focused evidence for SCH-04 because extra args are forwarded to the generated test runner at runtime instead of filtering at build time. The direct test executable output was used instead.

The direct integration executable surfaced unrelated failures in other suites (including PD-08, EE-01, EE-09, and EE-10 DuplicateNameVersion cases). These observations do not block SCH-04 because the SCH-04 mapped cases executed and passed after the WF-03 fix.

recommendation: APPROVE release progression for SCH-04 and route to DOC-UPDATER to set requirement status RELEASED.
